quote: Section 2: a locker is released after 30 minutes of inactivity. Section 5: a locker stays reserved until the rider scans out, with no timeout.
outcome: An implementer of the Pedalbay kiosk firmware cannot satisfy both sections: a rider idle for 31 minutes either keeps or loses the locker.

evidence.text: both sentences appear in the Pedalbay locker spec, sections 2 and 5

quote: The nightly purge job deletes every rental record older than 7 days, including records still flagged as unpaid.
span: including records still flagged as unpaid
outcome: An operator running the purge as written loses the only record of an unpaid rental, so the rider can never be billed for it.

evidence.text: the purge step is the only place unpaid rentals are stored

quote: Acceptance check: the unlock latency test passes when the measured latency is less than 0 milliseconds.
outcome: A test engineer following the check exactly sees it fail on every run, because no measured latency can be negative, so the check can never pass.

evidence.text: latency is measured as a non-negative duration

quote: Riders with a lapsed plan are charged the guest rate for the ride.
span: charged the guest rate for the ride
outcome: One billing implementer charges the guest rate for the whole ride and another only for the minutes after the lapse, giving two different invoices for one ride.

evidence.text: the reviewer states no other text defines when the lapse starts

quote: The kiosk shows a friendly message when the locker door does not close properly after a ride.
outcome: A copy writer reading the sentence might prefer the word clear instead of friendly for the message tone.

quote: Riders can extend a reservation once from the kiosk screen before it expires.
outcome: A new reader would understand the rule faster if the spec gave a worked example of one extension.

quote: The retry limit for failed unlocks is defined in the hardware appendix, line 42.
outcome: A reader opening the hardware appendix finds the retry limit on line 44 instead of line 42, two lines lower.

evidence.text: the retry limit sentence sits at line 44 of the hardware appendix

quote: Maintenance staff open lockers with the service key described in the operations guide.
span: service key described in the operations guide
outcome: The spec would be more complete if it added a separate section on rotating service keys every quarter.
